{{Top|leg}}
'''Kirbat the Unready''' was an individual who worked as a [[Chancellor (disambiguation)|chancellor]]. During Kirbat the Unready's chancellorship, a [[polysteel]] statue of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] [[Despot]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] was constructed in a [[Unidentified factory (Centares)|factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Centares/Legends|Centares]]. The Historian [[Bleys Harand]] mentioned Kirbat and the statue in his work ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'', which focused on finding an accurate depiction of Xim.<ref name="EGTW:AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kirbat the Unready was first mentioned in [[2013]] in the third installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of posts on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] featuring material cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. The post was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].
